title: 12th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/1/2026).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.

Preliminary debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem on Public Service Media discriminating between political parties, denying the Maldivian Democratic Party the chance to inform the public, and failing to ensure the editorial independence required by law.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the Bill to amend the Maldives Fisheries Act (Law No. 14/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo South MP Mohamed Alsan Ahmed.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's nominations of a non-resident ambassador to Cambodia and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and a non-resident ambassador to the Hellenic Republic (Greece).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to introduce a Constitution amendment bill, open debate on the PSM editorial-independence resolution, continue the Fisheries Act amendment, and take up an ambassadors report.
